metadata.title: Ransomware Resilience

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for surviving and recovering from ransomware and destructive malware attacks.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Backup isolation, recovery, and ransomware-resistant storage technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for ensuring recovery from ransomware without attacker cooperation.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Ransomware resilience mitigates ATT&CK impact techniques such as data encryption, destruction, and service disruption.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Mitigates Data Encrypted for Impact, Data Destruction, and Inhibit System Recovery techniques.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Ransomware resilience aligns to recovery and data restoration defensive techniques.

metadata.remarks: Ransomware Resilience defines the capability to withstand ransomware and destructive malware attacks by maintaining isolated, immutable recovery mechanisms and validated restoration processes. Control implementation is expressed at the capability level to ensure recoverability without ransom payment.

components.title: Isolated and Immutable Backups
components.description: Backups protected from ransomware through isolation, immutability, or write-once mechanisms.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Backups are isolated or immutable to prevent modification or deletion by ransomware.
Resilience mechanisms support recovery from ransomware-induced data loss.

components.title: Ransomware Recovery Workflows
components.description: Defined procedures for restoring systems from clean backups following ransomware infection.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Recovery workflows restore services without reliance on compromised systems or attacker keys.

components.title: Recovery Testing Against Ransomware
components.description: Testing and validation of recovery procedures under ransomware-impact scenarios.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Ransomware recovery procedures are tested to verify effectiveness under realistic attack conditions.
